bio.text: Thomas Sullivan is the Republican, Conservative and We The People candidate for New York State Assembly District 23 in Queens in the November 2026 election, according to the Rockaway Times.
The paper describes him as a small business owner and financial services professional and a 30-year U.S. Army Reserve veteran, raised in Brooklyn as the son of a retired NYPD detective.
His campaign website says his Army Reserve service included combat tours in Kuwait, Iraq and Afghanistan before he retired as a colonel.
The Wave reported in March 2024 that, in the previous election for the same Assembly seat, he lost to Stacey Pheffer Amato by 15 votes.
